name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) - Housing for All
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (पीएमएवाई) - सबके लिए आवास
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Government scheme providing affordable housing with financial assistance up to ₹2.67 lakh to urban poor and rural households for construction or purchase of a house.
summary_hi: शहरी गरीब और ग्रामीण परिवारों को घर निर्माण या खरीद के लिए ₹2.67 लाख तक की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली सरकारी योजना।
benefits: Credit-Linked Subsidy (CLSS): Interest subsidy of 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh for EWS/LIG
Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC): ₹1.5 lakh subsidy for construction of new house on own land (rural)
Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP): Houses built in partnership with private developers at affordable prices
In-Situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR): Using land as a resource for redevelopment of slums
Subsidy for purchase of ready-built house

who_can_apply: Economically Weaker Section (EWS): Annual family income up to ₹3 lakh
Low Income Group (LIG): Annual family income ₹3-6 lakh
Middle Income Group-I (MIG-I): Annual family income ₹6-12 lakh
Middle Income Group-II (MIG-II): Annual family income ₹12-18 lakh
Family should not own a pucca house in any part of India
Women ownership is mandatory for EWS/LIG categories
who_cannot_apply: Families who already own a pucca house anywhere in India
Families who have previously availed housing assistance from any government scheme
Families above the income thresholds for each category
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all adult family members

eligibility_rules.fail_msg: Should not own a pucca house
Family income exceeds MIG-II limit of ₹18L/year

how_to_apply: Fill in personal details, income, family members, and Aadhaar
Get a unique application number — save it for future reference
Alternatively, visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or municipal office

faq.q: Can I apply if I already have a home loan?
faq.a: Yes, if you have taken a loan after the PMAY notification date and do not own a pucca house, you can apply for the subsidy.

faq.q: My wife is the co-owner — does that satisfy women ownership?
faq.a: Yes, either sole or joint ownership with wife/grandmother/mother/daughter works for the women ownership requirement.

faq.q: How long does it take to get the subsidy?
faq.a: The subsidy is credited directly to your home loan account within 30-60 days of application approval.

faq.q: Can I use PMAY for home renovation?
faq.a: PMAY Urban does not cover renovation. However, PMAY-G (Rural) has a 'Retrofitting' component for existing kutcha houses in select cases.
